purpose: Planning catalogue and current coverage audit. This is not a runtime capability manifest and does not claim that every feature is exposed through the Studio UI.
benchmark: Public CapCut feature families across mobile, desktop and web. Exact availability varies by platform, region, account, rollout and subscription.
implementation_rule: Independent implementations only. Do not copy CapCut source code, private APIs, binaries, model weights, templates, music, fonts, stickers or protected assets.

categories.label: Project, media library and timeline
features: Canonical project JSON, revisions and D1-backed project/history APIs exist; full project manager, recovery UX and cross-device lifecycle remain incomplete.
Bounded undo/redo snapshots and revision persistence exist; automatic autosave and user-facing history/recovery UI remain incomplete.
Single-video upload and technical probing paths exist; multi-file video/audio/image/subtitle import and a full searchable media bin remain incomplete.
Searchable media bin, folders, labels, thumbnails and relinking
Multiple video, overlay, image, text, caption and audio tracks
Add, move, trim, split, delete and duplicate operations exist; slip, replace, group, linked-clip and broader reorder workflows remain missing.
Same-track ripple delete is implemented with overlap rejection; ripple insert/overwrite, cross-track ripple, snapping and timeline markers remain missing.
Track rename, lock, enabled state and mute controls exist; solo, hide, reorder and full track-level audio controls remain missing.
Detach audio, capture frame and freeze frame

categories.label: Clip transforms, framing and animation
features: Static position, scale, rotation and opacity plus fit/fill/stretch framing exist; manual crop rectangles, flip/mirror and anchor/pivot controls remain missing.
Custom project dimensions/frame rate and layered overlays are supported; a guided canvas/preset/background workflow is not complete.
Rendered position, scale, rotation and opacity keyframes with hold, linear, ease-in, ease-out, ease-in-out and cubic Bezier interpolation; crop/effect keyframes remain pending.
Easing, graph editor, interpolation and reusable animation presets
Animated pan, zoom, rotate, scale, fade, slide and motion paths
Copy, paste, remove and reset keyframes
Social format guides and safe-area overlays
Keyframe and speed graph zoom in/out, panning, fit-all and reset-view controls; touch-friendly as well as mouse-friendly

categories.label: Speed and time effects
features: Constant speed changes and reverse playback
Constant video playback speed and keyframed variable-speed ramps with real-render source-time verification; interactive graph editor and presets remain pending.
Constant speed and keyframed speed-curve source-time remapping are render-tested; fully coordinated audio, animation and retiming workflows remain incomplete.
Audio pitch controls when speed changes
Dedicated editable speed-curve graph with draggable/addable/removable control points, zoom in/out, pan, fit-to-clip, reset view and precise numeric speed/time editing

categories.label: Transitions, effects and compositing
features: Horizontal luma-map wipes in both directions with softness control and decoded-pixel verification; other wipe patterns remain pending.
Dissolve and horizontal luma wipe are render-tested; slide, push, split, blur, zoom, mask and dip transitions remain missing.
Basic brightness, chroma-key, contrast and saturation filters with rendered-pixel checks; advanced effect stacks and subject/body effects remain pending.
Blend modes, transparency and cross-track compositing
Shape masks, feathering and mask animation
A basic chroma-key effect path exists; advanced green-screen edge, spill and matte controls are not complete.
AI subject cutout and background removal

categories.label: Colour, lighting and image quality
features: Brightness, contrast and saturation are supported; full exposure, temperature, tint, gamma and white-balance controls remain missing.
Highlights, shadows, grain, vignette and sharpen

categories.label: Text, titles, stickers and graphics
features: Basic timed text/title/caption overlays with RGBA transparency and decoded-frame verification; advanced text animation, typography and templates remain pending.

Font family/size/weight, colour, outline, alignment/placement, letter and line spacing, background fill/opacity, and shadow colour/offset/opacity/blur are editable in Studio and offline render-tested through transparent ASS/libass overlays; editable title templates and text animation remain separate pending capabilities.
Text entrance, exit, loop and per-word animation
Editable title templates and reusable brand styles
Stickers, emoji, shapes, arrows, frames and overlays

Stability AI Community License is conditional; Cloudflare Workers Free cannot host generation and no dependable free GPU runtime or acceptable CPU latency has been verified. Native editable graphics take priority.

categories.label: Captions, transcription and localisation
features: SRT/VTT subtitle import/export, selected text-clip correction, transcript-driven word cuts and measured-silence review with individual approval are offline-verified; automatic speech recognition and advanced caption animation remain pending.

Whisper/whisper.cpp is a local MIT-licensed candidate with CPU support and a plausible free GitHub Actions runner path; automatic captions remain gated until representative real-footage quality, timestamp drift, language coverage and 30-minute runtime tests pass.

Source-linked timed word records can be imported from user-supplied timestamps, validated against media duration, searched lexically by exact word or phrase and mapped to constant-speed timeline clip instances. Existing word-timed caption clip creation remains supported; automatic speech recognition and timestamp generation are not included.
Caption templates, keyword highlights and animated captions
Karaoke/lyric captions when timing data exists
SRT and WebVTT sidecar import/export with tested text/timestamp round-trips to millisecond precision; malformed, empty, overlapping and over-limit cues are rejected.

Piper is a local GPL-3.0-or-later engine, but voice rights are model-specific and require checking each full training chain. No approved voice, output-quality benchmark or dubbing workflow is enabled.

Timed transcript search and inclusive word-range cuts are previewed against one selected source clip and applied only after explicit confirmation. Measured silence between adjacent words can also be reviewed and individually approved after fresh audio remeasurement. Multi-track A/V synchronisation and filler-word recognition remain pending.

categories.label: Audio and voice production
features: Multiple audio tracks mixed with video audio
Audio gain, fade-in/fade-out and mute support with decoded-audio verification; solo and pan remain pending.
Clip-level volume_db keyframes with decoded-audio verification; advanced track automation remains pending.
Audio analysis measures streams, silence and loudness; waveform display, beat-grid extraction and beat-aware timeline editing are not implemented.
Music and sound-effect library with licence metadata
Speech cleanup, silence and filler-word removal
Piper provides local TTS, but the engine is GPL-3.0-or-later and voice-model rights vary by training chain. Keep gated until one exact commercial-use voice and rendered output are verified.
Align separate camera, dialogue or recording clips by matching their audio waveforms.

categories.label: AI editing assistants
features: Gemini structured JSON planning and safe execution are wired to the 34-operation registry and covered by offline integration tests; a live account-backed Gemini-to-render acceptance test remains pending.
Auto cut by beats, speech pauses or instruction

FFmpeg measures technical silence intervals; transcript-aware review returns candidates between adjacent words and supports individually approved, freshly remeasured cuts. Filler-word recognition and automatic multi-track cleanup remain unimplemented.
FFmpeg returns candidate scene-change timestamps; semantic shot labels and visual confirmation are not provided.
Search media using names, transcripts or supported metadata
Subject-aware reframing for different aspect ratios
Face, body, hand and object tracking
AI title, caption, thumbnail and colour suggestions

categories.label: Generative AI creation
features: Image/video style transfer and animation looks
Generative expand, outpainting and object removal

categories.label: Photo and thumbnail design
features: Image clips support transforms and fit/fill/stretch framing; a standalone image-editing canvas and complete photo tools are missing.
Upscale, low-light enhancement, restoration and colourisation
Thumbnail, cover, poster and social graphic canvas
Export images separately from video projects

categories.label: Templates, stock media and creative assets
features: Searchable intro, outro, short-form, promo and slideshow templates
Editable templates with replaceable media slots
Effects, transitions, filters, titles, stickers, fonts, stock, music and SFX packs
Brand kit with logos, colours and approved fonts

categories.label: Export, delivery and sharing
features: Project dimensions and frame rate can be set and MP4 export is available; complete codec, bitrate, quality and audio export controls remain missing.
Audio codec, sample rate and channel controls
Cloud render jobs expose status and result information; full cancellation, retry, queue controls and robust job lifecycle UX remain incomplete.
Burned-in captions and separate subtitle files
Editable canonical project data is kept separately from rendered MP4 output; portable project package import/export remains missing.
Platform presets and optional direct sharing integrations
2K/4K and above, subject to benchmark and quota gates

categories.label: Cloud workspace and collaboration
features: D1-backed project/job metadata and revisions exist; multi-user ownership, asset storage, quota/retention controls and cross-device sync remain incomplete.
Cross-device project sync, backup and restore
Team workspaces, invitations, roles and permissions
Shared folders, asset libraries and brand kits
Project versions, activity history and conflict-safe editing
Presentation links and controlled download permissions

categories.label: Quality inspection, visual review and provenance
features: Measure source streams, black intervals, silence, loudness and candidate scene changes. Current implementation is technical/signal-level only; it does not approve semantic or artistic quality.
Generate contact sheets, sampled frames and playable review segments; record what a human or vision model actually inspected.
Compare source/reference and edited output for shot timing, composition, typography, motion and colour, with reviewable differences.
Record render inputs, tool actions, output hashes, quality findings and explicit review/approval checkpoints; add bounded retry/re-render loops.

mark_available_only_after: Studio controls connected to the canonical project model
save/reopen and regression tests where relevant
quota, timeout, cancellation and cleanup checks
release_policy.zero_budget: No paid billing, paid fallback or hidden credit use. Optional AI stays disabled until a genuinely free and licensed route is verified.
release_policy.production_warning: This catalogue is not evidence that all listed capabilities exist in the current app.

audit.scope_note: The 118 CapCut-style entries were retained and six missing cross-repository capabilities were added. The Stage 1 Studio implementation extended the 34-tool Stable baseline to 52 unique operations. Stage 2 adds six transcript operations for timed word import/search, preview/approval-gated transcript cuts, measured silence review and freshly remeasured approval-gated silence cuts, bringing the working registry to 58 unique operations.

status_definitions.prototype_verified: A limited supported subset has passed the relevant generated-media/render or integration assertions. This is not full feature-family parity.
status_definitions.partially_implemented: A real tool, API or engine path exists, but important parts of the broader capability are still absent.
status_definitions.under_test: Repository integration and offline tests exist; required live provider/account-backed acceptance remains outstanding.
status_definitions.planned: No usable implementation is currently verified.
status_definitions.gated_optional: The capability depends on optional models, services, licences or compute and remains disabled until the route and cost are approved.
